releases.body:
Built from 31f7328b on 2026-11-13.

Unreleased code — use a tagged release unless you are testing something specific.

Download with: gh release download nightly

Turn-0 file localization and verified target guardrails, dead-end reversal and
root-cause `FixPair` recall across marathon episodes, `deja bench live` and
`deja audit`, ephemeral `npx` launcher staging, and native IntelliJ Platform,
Neovim, CodeCompanion, and Tmux plugins.

### Added

- `UserPromptSubmit` localizes likely target files and verified test recipes at Turn 0 before the first file read. Strips `<fork-boilerplate>` envelopes and git/PR workflow footers on structured specs, matches quoted diagnostic strings and `cooccur.gob` neighbors, and attaches verified file guardrails (`standing`, `repo decision`, `reverted approach`, `prior decision`, `past breakage`) with cross-surface `.seen` deduplication.
- `PreToolUse` surfaces verified dead-end reversals with causal rationale, extracts edited symbols and root-cause explanations (`Why`) from self-corrected `FixPair` edit-test loops, and scans full episode history in 200+ message marathon sessions while blocking broad multi-file sweeps.
- `deja bench live [--json]` measures read-only `PreToolUse` actionable recall, dead-end reversals, ephemeral noise rate, and temporal Turn-0 localization replay across a repository without mutating `.hookseen` or injection logs.
- `deja audit [--json]` inspects detected agent stores for transcript counts and sizes, retention deletion risk (`cleanupPeriodDays`), preserved deleted sessions, recoverable edit paths, and wiring state, while `deja install` stages ephemeral `npx`/`bunx` binaries into persistent user storage so hooks keep working after cache eviction (#6036).
- IntelliJ Platform / JetBrains IDE plugin, native Neovim runtime plugin (`:Deja`, AI blame), CodeCompanion extension, and Tmux Plugin Manager (TPM) plugin (#6029, #6030, #6031, #6032).
- `deja sessions` records model, token usage, and tool-call counts per session (#6010).
- Memory guide for Muse Code and session-deletion guides for Grok Build, Senpi, and Command Code (#5995, #6009, #6013, #6015).

### Changed

- `deja stats` and `deja doctor` run faster on large stores, and README / translated README install instructions use OpenCode 2.x `plugin add` (#6012, #6014, #6017, #6022, #6026).
- `RecentSpokenAssistantTurnsForTerms` filters postings to spoken assistant records before applying `maxRecords`, and `UserPromptSubmit` shares candidate selection with `deja bench live`.

### Fixed

- Auto-synced `.deja/memory.jsonl` project decisions require multi-session confirmation (#6025).
- `PostCompaction` recovery preserves tail context and recent verification commands across compactions (#6019).
- JetBrains plugin drops deprecated platform APIs and passes Marketplace XML validation, and the Raycast extension unwraps v2 search hits (#6033, #6034).
- Windows ZCode detection checks `PATH` and `ProgramFiles` fallbacks for `ZCode.exe` (#6016, #6018).
- Enforced CLI boundary, environment, and parser contracts, respected shared-index modes/clients in `deja doctor`, and rejected whitespace-only paths and blank `delete` / `resume` prefixes (#5997, #5999, #6007, #6008, #6011).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(cli,docs): stage ephemeral npx binary, add deja audit, balance 43-agent positioning (#6036)
* feat(hook): turn-0 localization, target guardrails, and 0.24.2 release (#6038)
* feat(jetbrains): add IntelliJ Platform plugin (#6031)
* feat(nvim): add native Neovim runtime plugin for session recall and AI blame (#6029)
* feat(sessions): record model, token usage, and tool-call stats per session (#6010)
* feat(tmux,nvim): add TPM plugin and CodeCompanion extension (#6030)
### Fixes
* fix(cli,sources,embed): enforce CLI boundary, env, and parser contracts (#6011)
* fix(digest,search,orient): preserve tail context and recent verify commands across compactions (#6019)
* fix(doctor,delete): respect shared-index modes/clients and reject blank delete prefixes (#6008)
* fix(extensions): drop deprecated JetBrains APIs and unwrap Raycast v2 search hits (#6034)
* fix(jetbrains): replace em-dash in plugin

Repository memory (`.deja/memory.jsonl` and `deja review`), zonal BM25F and
corpus-learned collocation mining, multilingual live standing-rule and edit
guards across all 44 harnesses, Streamable HTTP MCP transport (`--http`), and
Devin CLI `PostCompaction` / Windsurf `deja rules sync` parity.

### Added

- `.deja/memory.jsonl` repository memory, `deja repo`, and `deja review` track file- and commit-linked decisions and traps. Hooks auto-seed and evolve repo memory, surfacing coupled files, caller/signature guards, test assertion predictors, and error remedies (#5964, #5981).
- Zonal BM25F field weighting and NPMI collocation mining improve multilingual recall across EN, RU, ZH, and JA. Adds 1-hop associative query expansion, Dirichlet log-odds discourse marker learning, and trajectory-verified conclusion synthesis (#5989).
- Live turn-pair refusal capture (`syncLiveSessionRules`) and edit-payload guards (`old_string` / `new_string`) work across all 44 harnesses. Covers plugin, sidecar, and deferred harnesses including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Antigravity, Goose, Pi, Cline, Amp, DeepSeek, OpenClaw, Hermes, Prime, and Reasonix.
- Devin CLI `PostCompaction` capture and recovery packet delivery from `sessions.db` (`compact/prior_node_ids`), plus `deja rules sync` (with Cascade's 6,000-character cap) and status bar parity for Windsurf and Kiro IDE (`docs/registry/registry.json`).
- Opt-in Streamable HTTP transport (`deja mcp --http`) and `DEJA_EMBED_BATCH` batching control (#5968, #5969).
- DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) search controls with customizable keys and a scoped `/deja` command (#5978, #5990).
- SpecStory, Basic Memory, Mem0, and MiniMax Code guides (#5977, #5991, #5994).

### Changed

- `deja embed` semantic search reads only winning record offsets and calibrates the cosine floor for low-cosine models and distributions (#5979, #5980).
- Qwen Code and Gemini CLI MCP recall blocks hand off through `PostToolUse` so the TUI stays collapsed.

### Fixed

- Antigravity MCP config marks `deja` eager (`forceAllToolsEager` and `tools.deja.eager`), Kilo Code and Kiro `deja install` auto-allow `deja` (`alwaysAllow` / `autoApprove`), and Antigravity/Goose deferred hooks surface pre-edit file guards on `read_file` and `view_file` (#5987, #5992).
- ZCode Desktop 3.17+ hook wiring writes to `config.json` and `deja doctor` reads the active file (#5960, #5984).
- OpenCode session reader reads `session_v2` when the legacy table is a leftover (#5962).
- Tightened redactor patterns, friction signatures, compaction carry, recall project scoping, and duplicate hook-check deduplication in `deja doctor` (#5968, #5973, #5974, #5982, #5985, #5986, #5988).
- Shell completion for `deja last`, `deja stats`, and `deja show --offset`/`--limit` stops suggesting flags while an option awaits its value, `deja show` treats whitespace-only session IDs as missing, and `deja blame` refuses blank paths before and after `--` (#5955, #5961, #5983, #5993).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(dsh): search controls with customizable keys and a scoped /deja (#5978) (@takomitkm)
* feat(embed): calibrate semantic floor for low-cosine models and distributions (#5980)
* feat(hooks): auto-seed repo memory and wire coupled files, file guards, and error remedies across hooks (#5981)
* feat(hooks,plugins,devin,windsurf): unify 44-harness live turn-pair rules, edit payload guards, and Devin/Windsurf parity (#6000)
* feat(index,hooks): add zonal BM25F, collocation mining, and multilingual hook guards (#5989)
* feat(mcp): add opt-in Streamable HTTP transport (--http) (#5969)
* feat(repo): add .deja/memory.jsonl repository memory and deja repo CLI
* feat(repo): auto-evolve file- and commit-linked .deja/memory.jsonl (#5964)
* feat(review): add deja review and repo-scoped rules candidates
### Fixes
* fix(blame): refuse a blank path before and after -- (#5993) (@Sharawey74)
* fix(completion): leave last and stats option values alone (#5983) (@rajshadow)
* fix(completion): offe

Sub-50 ms hook and MCP hot path, project X-Ray and symbol decision recall,
1-tool `deja` MCP mode guidance and argument aliases across harnesses, OpenCode
2.x plugin upgrade handling, and asymmetric Nemotron / NVIDIA NIM embeddings.

### Added

- `deja orient` and `PreToolUse` surface co-change file pairs, symbol decisions, and verified traps. Pre-flight hooks also surface targeted test priority and command remedies before an agent edits or runs a command (#5882, #5896).
- `PreCompact` captures modified files and symbol decisions so compaction keeps the active working set. `apply_patch` edits are also indexed into file blame and history (#5896).
- `deja embed` supports asymmetric NVIDIA NIM and Nemotron models with automatic `input_type` retry. Passes `"passage"` when indexing and `"query"` when searching (#5950).
- Native Antigravity plugin bundle (`antigravity-plugin/`) and `deja stats --card` on first install.
- Configuration reference for `~/.config/deja` and `policy.json`, plus JetBrains AI and session-deletion guides (#5869, #5943).

### Changed

- Hook and MCP recall bound session record reads to tail windows and skip unused tool-output inflation. Transcript change scans prefilter by mtime, and compressed `.jsonl.zst` Codex rollouts stream without holding them in memory (#5901, #5907, #5908, #5927, #5928).

### Fixed

- Hook leads and `/deja` prompts name 1-tool `deja` modes (`"context"` and `"recall"`), and `spreadQ` accepts subject aliases (`session_id`, `file_path`, `output`, `fact`). `dejaCallNames` also recognizes MCP-prefixed `deja` tool calls.
- `deja install opencode-auto` replaces the legacy OpenCode 1.x TUI status plugin with the 2.x server plugin on upgrade, and registers `home_bottom` before `home-tips`.
- `deja doctor` detects approved Codex hooks from non-primary event pins and live hook execution in `.live` / `.hookseen` (#5948).
- Hook concurrency, detached refreshers, and CLI flag validation handle spawn recall locks, `.hookseen` serialization, Windows path separators, `recap --json --limit`, and blank arguments in `promote`, `remember --project`, `handoff`, `fix`, `view --out`, and `restore -o` (#5899, #5904, #5909, #5910, #5911, #5915, #5929, #5930, #5931, #5932, #5933, #5945, #5949).
- `go test ./...` runs hermetically in root and minimal containers without `sqlite3` or `zstd` installed (#5947).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(antigravity): add native antigravity-plugin bundle for marketplace
* feat(embed): send input_type for asymmetric Nemotron and NVIDIA NIM models
* feat(hook): add symbol decision recall, targeted test priority, and pre-flight remedies
* feat(install): mention deja stats --card in first-install proof line
* feat(orient,hook): surface project X-Ray, co-change pairs, and verified traps (#5882)
* feat: compaction edit ledger, apply_patch file history, and recall signal filtering (#5896)
### Fixes
* fix(cli): handle positional arguments after --
* fix(cli): quote Windows test path and tighten flag parsing and completions
* fix(cmd): serialize in-process hook state and restore how dash-query hint
* fix(cmd,sources): restore test refresher sentinel, cross-platform pid check, and fast antigravity changes
* fix(codex): assign err on its own line, as the linter asks (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(codex): satisfy the shadow lint and cover the rest of zstdScan (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(codex): stream a compressed rollout instead of holding it in memory (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(doctor): detect approved Codex hooks from non-primary pins and live execution
* fix(dsh,usage): retain opening digest across refreshContext and update log JSON contract (#5904, #5899)
* fix(fix): ignore blank arguments in the error text (#5911) (@ZYZ666-RGB)
* fix(hook): a detached refresh takes the warmup's budget (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(hook): a refresher waiting on the index lock is not replaced (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(hook): normalize path separators in commandProjectCandidates on Windows (#5915)
* fix(hooks): bound prompt candidat

### Added

- **VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Antigravity extension (`vshulcz.deja-status`, `extensions/vscode`).** Shows a live session memory counter in the status bar and runs `deja stats` or `deja install --auto` on click (#5859).
- **Raycast extension (`extensions/raycast`).** Adds `Search Sessions` and `Recent Sessions` commands on macOS for searching across all indexed coding agent sessions and copying `deja resume <id>` (#5829).
- **`deja-reflect` skill (`skills/deja-reflect/SKILL.md`).** Standalone end-of-session reflection skill that inspects `deja notes` and `deja friction`, distills durable project invariants, and stores confirmed notes via `deja remember` (#5841).
- **Incremental offset parsing for Antigravity and Cursor transcripts** and symbol-level blame in `deja blame` (#5863).

### Fixed

- **Status line multi-harness audit** across OpenCode, Antigravity, Claude Code, and Cursor (`statusline`), plus `recall_context` tool name alignment in `hook-context` and `deja doctor` self-version check (#5850, #5851, #5864).
- **Claude Code and Codex plugin hooks (`claude-plugin/hooks/deja.sh`, `codex-plugin/hooks/deja.sh`).** Require explicit confirmation before acting on recalled `User said (this project)` lines or running `deja rules sync`, and point missing-binary hints solely at `brew install deja-vu` (#5838, #5860, #5865).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(sources,search): incremental offset parsing for antigravity/cursor and symbol blame (#5863)
* feat: resolve remaining open issues across recall, statusline, stats, docs and extensions (#5864)
### Fixes
* fix(claude-plugin,codex-plugin): drop moving @latest from missing-binary hint (#5865)
* fix(claude-plugin,hooks): require confirmation on recalled user lines and rules sync (#5838) (#5860)
### Performance
* perf(index,digest): cut relevance allocations 4x, cache worktree roots, and enforce wiring invariants (#5835)
### Documentation
* docs(changelog,extensions): prepare 0.23.5 release and align extension READMEs (#5878)
* docs(guide): put index-before-delete and write-back commands at the top of cleanup and recovery guides (#5834) (@shu-chen-dot-ca)
* docs(readme,extensions,site): symmetric conversion, nav star CTA, CITATION.cff, and context7.json (#5848) (#5861)
### Other
* chore: pin the manifests to 0.23.4 (#5828)
* refactor(cli,index,digest,search): split hook/store/digest domains and fix Unicode word boundaries (#5844)
* refactor(cli,index,search,redact): split 10 domain files into cohesive units under 1,980 lines (#5845)
* refactor(cli,index,search,sources): split 9 domain files so zero files exceed 1,359 lines (#5846)
* refactor(cli,sources,digest): unify hook envelope adoption, word-form counting, and duplicate helpers (#5840)
* refactor(index,deja): unify synced convention conversion and OrigID identity lookup (#5853)
* refactor(index,search,cli): split bounded domains and enforce cross-package invariants (#5839)
* refactor(model,index,deja): unify session lineage and decision lifecycle resolution (#5852)
* refactor(model,query): introduce DDD domain value methods, unify ProjectInScope, and enforce AST invariants (#5849)
* refactor: unify harness wiring, parser project ACL, and index sidecar updates (#5855)
* refactor: unify identity resolution, handover filters, and sidecar scope (#5854)
* refactor: unify manifest visibility, index exclusion gate, and composite identity (DDD Stages E-K) (#5858)

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/main/install.sh | sh
go install github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/cmd/deja@v0.23.5
brew install deja-vu
```
